author: SickProdigy
description: Connect each Discord server to an approved Navidrome library, manage linked users, browse recent albums, and announce new additions.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild connection selections, announcement settings, announced album IDs, and Discord-to-Navidrome account mappings. It does not store generated user passwords. Navidrome administrator credentials are read from Red shared API tokens.
install_msg: Store credentials privately with `[p]set api navidrome_NAME username,YOUR_USER password,YOUR_PASSWORD`, approve the endpoint with `[p]navidromeowner connection add NAME URL`, then run `[p]navidromeset setup`.
name: Navidrome
short: Per-server Navidrome connections, linked users, and album announcements
